id: NZ2: follow-up of NZ1 - white-noise tolerance at 15 N (NZ1: 20 N not tolerated, 0.75; LN2D: 10 N tolerated)
registered: 2026-11-04, after NZ1 and before any NZ2 run. A measurement, not a directional prediction.
arm: as NZ1 (oracle in the hold decision, capture-prediction release only); ref (no error) and w15 (white 15 N per axis)

conditions.pushes: y+ (lateral) 0.2 s impulse, F in {57.5, ..., 80} N

measures.H_low: zero-step holds among the 24 runs with F <= 70 N
measures.pre-push: runs with a step or fall before the push (reported)

decision: white 15 N counts as tolerated if H_low(w15) >= 0.9 H_low(ref) (the NZ1 criterion)
